Salman Rushdie Attacker Hadi Matar Found Guilty In Federal Terrorism Trial
videos
Published on Jul 30, 2026 09:43 am IST
Share Via
Copy Link
A federal jury convicted Hadi Matar on terrorism-related charges in connection with the 2022 attack on author Salman Rushdie. The verdict marks a major development in the high-profile case, following a trial centred on the stabbing that shocked the literary world.
